operations.name: A Letter of Credit with the Bruges Exchange
operations.description: coin I no longer have to carry or guard

operations.name: A Half-Share in a Wool Warehouse
operations.description: a stake on the quay, bought with an antiquarian's coin

operations.text: An antiquarian recognizes the worth of my father's old coral string as a relic of Ragusan craft long fallen from fashion and pays handsomely; I fold the coin into a letter of credit at the Bruges Exchange and a half-share in a wool warehouse on the quay, more useful currency for this age than red beads.
